title: Aftersales Administrator
meta_desc: Aftersales Administrator job in Gżira, Malta supporting the parts and service teams of an automotive group. Maltese and English required. Apply now.
experience: Previous experience in a similar administrative role would be considered an asset
qualifications: O-Level standard of education; fluency in Maltese and English; good computer literacy including Microsoft Office
about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established automotive group in Malta, for an organised and detail-oriented Aftersales Administrator to join its team in Gżira.

You will give administrative support to the Parts and Service departments: preparing orders and customs documents, recording stock, running the Parts Warranty Room and helping with brand warranty claims, so that daily paperwork is handled accurately and on time.

The role suits someone who enjoys administrative work and wants to build a career in the automotive industry. It is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary, health insurance and employee discounts.
responsibilities: Prepare and maintain customer-specific orders, stock orders, customs clearance documentation and customer notification letters
Keep records organised and carry out general filing and administrative duties
Manage the Parts Warranty Room, keeping inventory records accurate and handling parts in line with brand policies
Help the Parts team with enquiries on parts availability, pricing, delivery estimates and order status
Create Goods Received Notes (GRNs) and make sure parts are recorded and entered into stock promptly
Prepare and submit departmental reports within set deadlines
Support Service Advisors and the Customer Care team with filing, Excel spreadsheets and data entry
Assist with processing and following up brand warranty claims
Comply with company policies and health and safety regulations, using the protective clothing and equipment provided when required
Attend relevant training sessions organised by the company
Carry out other administrative duties assigned by the Aftersales Manager
requirements: Fluency in Maltese and English, written and spoken
Good computer literacy, including Microsoft Office applications
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines and work well within a team
offer: The opportunity to develop your experience within an established automotive group
preferred: Previous experience in a similar administrative role
company: Our client is a well-established automotive group in Malta whose Parts and Service departments operate from Gżira.
location_text: Gżira lies on Malta's north-east coast along the Marsamxett Harbour promenade facing Manoel Island, a short walk from Sliema and Ta' Xbiex, with frequent buses to Valletta and the rest of the island.
howto: If you are organised and want to grow your career in the automotive industry, apply online through Outreach Recruitment using the form on this page. We aim to respond to all applications within 3–5 business days.
faq: What does an Aftersales Administrator do?

You support the Parts and Service departments with orders, customs documents, stock records and GRNs, run the Parts Warranty Room, help with warranty claims and assist Service Advisors and Customer Care with filing, spreadsheets and data entry.

Previous experience in a similar administrative role is an asset but not essential. You need an O-Level standard of education and good Microsoft Office skills.
